verdict.rationale: Otter's enterprise page documents a first-party option to keep organizational data out of AI model training. It appears limited to Enterprise and requires contacting an account manager rather than a self-serve setting. Community reading of the privacy statement (otter-comm-6) says recordings are used, anonymized, as training data by default, which fits an opt-out offered only to enterprises. Missing for 10: a self-serve opt-out control for individual or non-enterprise users, documentation of the scope and mechanics of the exclusion, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the opt-out works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Keep your organization's data out of AI model training. Contact your account manager to get started.
